query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

Material Issues / Green Buildings

[Content]
As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

results.text: The Group promotes low-carbon office and the green philosophy throughout the Group. On the one hand, the Group uses building management technologies such as air-conditioning energy-saving management, intelligent lighting system, and intelligent control electronic equipment to save energy and reduce carbon emissions. The Group also organizes environmental training and low-carbon office case sharing sessions from time to time to enhance the environmental awareness of its staff.

In addition, the Group promotes online internal meetings to reduce carbon emissions from travel. The Group also organizes environmental training and low-carbon office case sharing sessions from time to time to enhance the environmental awareness of its staff.

results.text: The project is designed in accordance with the ultra-low energy consumption, green building three-star, and healthy building three-star certification standards. At present, it was awarded the 'Ultra-low Energy Building' certificate (' 超低 能耗建築 ' 認證證書 ) by the China Association of Building Energy Efficiency. It has obtained the ultra-low energy consumption and healthy building two-star certification. It is planned to obtain green building and healthy building three-star certification after delivery and operation commences. The project will create an indoor 'five balances systems', namely balanced temperature, balanced oxygen level, balanced humidity, balanced cleanliness and balanced tranquility. The project can effectively reduce the consumption of non-renewable resources such as coal, natural gas, electricity and water, ease the pressure of energy shortage, reduce the emission of pollutants such as carbon dioxide, and realize the friendly symbiosis of people, buildings and the environment. According to the preliminary calculations, the annual emission of carbon dioxide in the operation of the ultra-low energy consumption building of the project is 0.07 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent per square meter. Compared with the conventional residential buildings in the 1980s, the project can achieve an annual emission reduction of carbon dioxide per square meter of 0.058 tonnes.
